# BlogFactory documentation

BlogFactory is a self-hosted, MCP-first control plane for content operations. Agents work through site-scoped MCP tools; people review changes and can send an approved version to a selected CMS as a draft. BlogFactory does not give agents live publishing or deletion authority.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://blogfactory.io/docs): task-focused guides for operators and MCP users.
- [Getting started](https://blogfactory.io/docs/getting-started): product model and the source evidence to CMS-draft workflow.
- [Self-hosting](https://blogfactory.io/docs/self-hosting): Docker Compose install, readiness, backup, restore, and upgrade guidance.
- [MCP connections](https://blogfactory.io/docs/mcp): OAuth, personal tokens, scopes, tool catalog, and Review Card behavior.
- [Content review](https://blogfactory.io/docs/content-review): revision-aware editing, review packets, preflight, and explicit approval.
- [Search Growth](https://blogfactory.io/docs/search-growth): Search Console data boundaries and operational workflow.
- [Operations](https://blogfactory.io/docs/operations): environment, migrations, routing, and production verification.
- [Architecture](https://blogfactory.io/docs/architecture): runtime surfaces, tenancy, safety boundaries, and service ownership.
- [Help Center](https://blogfactory.io/help): symptom-based setup, connection, delivery, and troubleshooting answers.

## Authoritative source

The public source documentation in the BlogFactory repository is canonical: https://github.com/BoraGkc/blogfactory/tree/main/docs

## Product boundaries

- Self-hosted first; BlogFactory Cloud is coming soon.
- Users bring their own AI credentials.
- MCP capabilities are site-scoped and draft-only.
- Never expose credentials, tokens, prompts, article bodies, or provider responses in audit records.
